signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: Own and drive product initiatives across notifications, sharing, and mobile user flows .
Define and optimize engagement loops , including push notifications, in-app messaging, and social sharing mechanics.
Partner with engineering and design to deliver intuitive, high-quality mobile experiences across iOS and Android.
Use data and user insights to identify opportunities to improve activation, retention, and engagement .
Write clear product requirements, define success metrics, and ensure high-quality execution.
